title: Oxley Knowledge Lattice
text:
Oxley Knowledge Lattice

notes:
Recent discovery -> moved to evaluation. Oxley runs a knowledge-base SaaS for mid-market B2B customers (docs, release notes, FAQs). Primary ask: embeddings + reranker stack to surface canonical answers and surface-turn reranking to increase precision at low latency. Indexing target: ~1.2M docs (avg 400 tokens) -> expect ~4M passage embeddings post-split. Traffic: very spiky; steady-state QPS target 300-500, peak bursts to 1k for product incidents. Cost sensitivity: internal goal <$0.002/query average (embeddings + rerank).\n\nNotes from demo: "Liked Redwood streaming API and model routing — want hosted first, may explore dedicated later." AE pointed out smart-routing for cheaper fallbacks. Customer cares about tail latency: p95 <120ms for retrieval+rerank when using a 3-stage pipeline (ANN -> embeddings rerank -> distilled reranker). Legal flagged data residency for EU customers (subset of corpus).\n\nQuotes: "We cannot have >200ms p95 during incident surges or PS will be flooded." — Head of Platform. POC ask: show 2-week perf run with synthetic QPS 500 p95, cost breakdown per 10k queries, and reranker throughput numbers.

next_step:
Finalize P50 perf report and schedule pricing sensitivity call

blockers:
latency SLA definition (p95/p99)
legal sign-off on data residency clause
final budget approval from finance

timeline:
2026-01-15: Intro call (AE + SE) — high-level use case, confirmed doc counts
2026-02-02: Demo — live hosted API walkthrough, streaming and routing explained
2026-02-22: Fireflies demo transcript uploaded (ff_2026-02-22_oxley_demo)
2026-03-01: Performance deep-dive with infra (ff_2026-03-01_perfcall)
2026-03-05: Security questionnaire sent; legal requested data residency clause

poc_milestones:
Week 1: ingest 100k docs, validate embedding distribution and shard strategy
Week 2: run ANN candidate gen at 500 QPS, measure recall@10 and latency
Week 3: integrate lightweight transformer reranker (distil-rerank) and measure end-to-end p95
Week 4: cost analysis and final run at spiky traffic (1k bursts), produce P50/P95/P99 report

technical_requirements:
Support for incremental indexing + efficient upserts (daily batch + live edits)
ANN latency budget: retrieval+rerank p95 <120ms (goal 80-100ms)
Embedding dimension preference: 1536 or quantized 1024 for cost tradeoff
Reranker must accept candidate set sizes 32-128 and work in streaming mode
Automatic fallback to cheaper model variant during capacity constraints

sizing_estimates:
Docs: 1.2M (avg 400 tokens) -> passages 3.2-4.0M
Storage: estimated 45-70GB of raw embedding vectors (float16 quantization planned)
QPS: steady 300-500, peak bursts to 1000 for incident windows
Throughput need: reranker capacity ~1200 qps equivalent if batched; prefer server-side batching

preferred_models:
open-embedding-1536 (dense)
distil-rerank-v1 (on-top)
fallback: small-gen-3b for low-cost responses
